info.text: Building full-stack web apps with TypeScript, React and Next.js.
Learning backend: APIs, databases and system design

featured.title: CoinTrack
featured.summary: A crypto portfolio tracker: log your buys and sells, then see what your holdings are worth today and how much you've gained or lost.
featured.why: Pulls live prices from the CoinGecko API, charts portfolio value over time, and keeps accounts safe with hashed passwords and prepared SQL statements throughout.

featured.title: Calorie Tracker
featured.summary: Log what you eat, set a daily calorie goal, and see how the last seven days went.
featured.why: A full-stack TypeScript app on the Next.js App Router, with Supabase for sign-in and storage and a chart-based weekly report.

featured.title: MT5 Expert Advisor
featured.summary: A trading bot for MetaTrader 5 that opens trades when fast and slow moving averages cross and RSI confirms the move.
featured.why: Object-oriented MQL5 split into small classes (signals, positions, grid, trailing stop, drawdown guard, on-chart dashboard). It checks the trend on three timeframes before every trade.
